fields.benefits_en: Boosts immune system, exhibits strong antibacterial and antifungal properties, and acts as a natural insect repellent.
fields.benefits_sw: Huongeza kinga ya mwili, ina nguvu kubwa ya kuua bakteria na fangasi, na hufukuza wadudu wadogo kwa asili.
fields.medicinal_uses_en: Used in treating skin disorders, dental plaque reduction, managing blood sugar levels, and combating malaria symptoms.
fields.medicinal_uses_sw: Hutumika kutibu magonjwa ya ngozi, kupunguza uchafu wa meno, kudhibiti sukari mwilini, na kupambana na dalili za malaria.

fields.benefits_en: Deeply hydrates the skin, rich in antioxidants, promotes wound healing, and supports cellular regeneration.
fields.benefits_sw: Hulainisha na kurutubisha ngozi, ina viondoa sumu mwilini, huharakisha kupona kwa vidonda, na kusaidia kuzalisha seli mpya za ngozi.
fields.medicinal_uses_en: Excellent for treating sunburns, minor cuts, skin irritation, digestive health improvements, and reducing inflammation.
fields.medicinal_uses_sw: Ni nzuri kwa kutibu majeraha ya moto, mikwaruzo midogo, miwasho ya ngozi, kuboresha mfumo wa mmeng'enyo, na kupunguza maumivu au kuvimba.

fields.benefits_en: Highly nutritious superfood, rich in vitamins A, C, and E, potassium, calcium, and essential amino acids.
fields.benefits_sw: Chakula chenye virutubisho vingi mno, kina vitamini A, C, na E, potasiamu, kalisi, na asidi muhimu za amino.
fields.medicinal_uses_en: Used to manage high blood pressure, reduce inflammation, lower blood cholesterol, and combat malnutrition.
fields.medicinal_uses_sw: Hutumika kudhibiti shinikizo la juu la damu, kupunguza uvimbe, kushusha mafuta mabaya mwilini (cholesterol), na kupambana na utapiamlo.

fields.benefits_en: Rich in aromatic essential oils, acts as a natural antioxidant, antibacterial, and respiratory support.
fields.benefits_sw: Kina mafuta yenye harufu nzuri na faida kubwa, kina viondoa sumu, huua bakteria, na kusaidia mfumo wa hewa.
fields.medicinal_uses_en: Used to treat coughs, colds, fever, abdominal pains, diarrhea, and skin infections.
fields.medicinal_uses_sw: Hutumika kutibu kikohozi, mafua, homa, maumivu ya tumbo, kuhara, na maambukizi ya ngozi.

fields.benefits_en: High content of Vitamin C and dietary fiber, supports heart health, and strengthens the immune system.
fields.benefits_sw: Kina kiasi kikubwa cha Vitamini C na nyuzinyuzi za chakula, husaidia afya ya moyo, na kuimarisha kinga ya mwili.
fields.medicinal_uses_en: Guava leaves are used for managing diarrhea, sore throat, coughs, and regulating blood glucose levels.
fields.medicinal_uses_sw: Majani ya mpera hutumika kutibu kuhara, maumivu ya koo, kikohozi, na kudhibiti viwango vya sukari kwenye damu.

fields.benefits_en: Provides cooling sensations, relaxes gastrointestinal muscles, and freshens breath.
fields.benefits_sw: Hutoa hisia ya baridi na kuburudisha, hulegeza misuli ya mfumo wa chakula, na kusafisha harufu ya kinywa.
fields.medicinal_uses_en: Alleviates irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), headaches, nausea, indigestion, and common cold symptoms.
fields.medicinal_uses_sw: Hupunguza matatizo ya tumbo (IBS), maumivu ya kichwa, kichefuchefu, kiungulia, na dalili za mafua.

fields.benefits_en: Rich source of plant-based protein, dietary fiber, and essential minerals like iron and folate.
fields.benefits_sw: Chanzo kikubwa cha protini ya mimea, nyuzinyuzi za chakula, na madini muhimu kama chuma na folate.
fields.medicinal_uses_en: Used in traditional medicine to manage diabetes, treat dysentery, reduce fever, and soothe toothaches.
fields.medicinal_uses_sw: Hutumika katika tiba asili kudhibiti ugonjwa wa kisukari, kutibu kuhara damu, kupunguza homa, na kutibu maumivu ya meno.

fields.benefits_en: High nitrogen-fixing plant that enriches soil, rich in saponins and antioxidants.
fields.benefits_sw: Mmea unaorutubisha udongo kwa kuongeza naitrojeni, una saponins na viondoa sumu mbalimbali.
fields.medicinal_uses_en: Used for anti-inflammatory treatments, wound healing, relieving sore throats, and treating skin eruptions.
fields.medicinal_uses_sw: Hutumika kupunguza uvimbe, kutibu vidonda, kupunguza maumivu ya koo, na kutibu upele au ugonjwa wa ngozi.

fields.benefits_en: Contains forskolin which activates cellular enzymes, supports cellular metabolism and circulation.
fields.benefits_sw: Ina forskolin ambayo huamsha vimeng'enya vya seli, husaidia kimetaboliki na mzunguko wa damu.
fields.medicinal_uses_en: Used to treat respiratory disorders like asthma, high blood pressure, digestive issues, and skin allergies.
fields.medicinal_uses_sw: Hutumika kutibu matatizo ya mfumo wa hewa kama pumu, shinikizo la juu la damu, matatizo ya tumbo, na mzio (allergy) ya ngozi.
